## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Direction as the body proposes

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:33Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx` (the operator list at `:162`) and the field list the list view hands it ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`); paths re-read on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`.

- **Why p3:** the builder works, but starts on a hidden field and lists system fields first.
- **Direction:**
  - hidden fields are not offered
  - fields follow the view's column order, with system fields grouped last
  - a new condition starts on the first visible column
  - one empty-check pair per field type, unless the type really distinguishes empty from null (then a hint says how)
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

Claim: PM loop round 3

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (the field list it hands `<FilterBuilder>` at about `:4595`, and the new condition's default field);
- `packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx` (the operator list, `is_empty` / `is_null` at about `:160`–`:165`, and the default field of an added condition);
- the tests beside them;
- `.changeset/11810-*.md`.

`FilterBuilder` has other callers (`fields`' `FilterConditionField`, the Studio dataset and widget inspectors, `config-field-renderer`). A change to its shared behaviour must keep them correct, and the dev names each one. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**` is not on it. Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui plugin-list + components: the list view hands FilterBuilder every field, hidden system fields first, and an added condition starts on the first of them (the hidden Organization); the builder offers both "Is empty" and "Is null" for a select field | the platform path: field metadata marks hidden fields, the view declares its column order, and the spec distinguishes $null/$exists from the empty check only where a type can hold '' | every end user who adds a filter to a list (showcase Tasks → Filter → Add filter)`
Thread-read: 6043301317
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking. No `area:records` card is in flight. No open objectui PR touches the files above (read 2026-10-07T20:51Z; open: #11832, #11831, #11600, #11069).

Why `Clause-②: no`: an ordering, filtering and default fix. A new published prop or type member on `FilterBuilder` (for example a per-caller operator policy) would widen `@object-ui/components`' public surface. If the fix needs one, the dev reports it before opening the PR, and the seat amends this line.

Claim amendment — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-07T22:29Z. It amends claim `6046638726` after the dev's `Clause-②` stop (report `6048143784`). The claim stands otherwise.

- **`Clause-②: yes`** (was `no`). The ruling's hint ("one empty-check pair per field type, unless the type really distinguishes empty from null (then a hint says how)", triage `6043301317`) needs two new keys, `filterBuilder.emptyCheckHint.text` and `.list`, in `@object-ui/i18n`'s ten packs. `./locales` and `./locales/*` are in that package's `exports`, so the keys are published accept-set: an additive widening of the public surface. Everything else in the change adds no export, prop or type member.
- **File surface, added:** `packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru,zh}.ts` (the two keys only), and `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` (its quoted-span count, 71 → 75, for the hint's four quoted labels).
- **The dev's open question, answered A.** The hint is the ruling's own text, so dropping it (B) would ship text columns with two unexplained pairs, the confusion the card reports. The same reasoning answered objectui#11645's added keys.
- **What `yes` brings:**
  - The changeset declares at least `minor`. `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/components` are in the `fixed` group, so one `minor` lifts the group; the branch's `patch` is raised in a patch round.
  - The PR body carries `Clause-②: yes` at line start.
  - A contract-review-tier record (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, an isolated reviewer) is owed on the PR before it is queued. The seat runs it.

Claim amendment 2 — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-07T23:06Z. It amends claim `6046638726` (already amended by `6048182477`) after the contract review on PR objectui#11836 (`6048648388`, FAIL on head `78fb73b`). The claim stands otherwise.

- **File surface, added:** `packages/components/package.json` (its `@objectstack/spec` range only), and `pnpm-lock.yaml` (the importer specifier the range change moves, regenerated with the repo's tooling and never edited by hand).
- **Why:** the branch makes `@object-ui/components`' published entry import `expandEmptyOperator` from `@objectstack/spec/data`. That function first ships in `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 (objectstack `b810ddb6`; npm 17.5.0, published 2026-09-29), while the package still declares `^17.0.0`. The seat measured this independently while the review ran. The remedy follows the repo's precedent (`@object-ui/plugin-form`'s floor raise beside `deriveInlineGridColumns`): raise the floor to `^17.5.0` in the same PR, and name it in the changeset.
- **Not filed:** the dev's Sort-picker observation (the list's Sort picker may offer the hidden `__search` column), which the review escalated, is inferred from reading the code, not measured. Without a measured reach the filing gate is not met, so it stays in the PR's Acceptance notes.
- A fresh contract-review record is owed on the new head.
